name: spec-md
description: The single /spec-md skill for *.spec.md work. It authors or updates Open Knowledge Format specs that capture a system's intent, behavior, and verification so humans and agents stay aligned, and it checks specs or reports test-case coverage. The skill identifies which job the request needs, or presents the options when the intent is unclear. One root SKILL.md — no commands and no nested skills — so it surfaces as the bare /spec-md, with no colon-suffixed sub-commands.
